name: docs-sync
description: Documentation sync (docs-sync) — use after code or configuration changes (a directory deleted or moved, a port, command or dependency changed, a large refactor merged) when agent instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), READMEs, rules (.claude/rules), skills or docs no longer match reality. Use on "sync the docs" (문서 현행화), "update the docs" (문서 최신화), "refresh the README" (README 갱신), "check for doc drift" (문서 드리프트 확인), "docs-sync", "clean up leftover references" (남은 참조 정리), and right before opening a PR that changed behavior, paths, versions or numbers. Memory audits belong to memory-factcheck, AGENTS.yaml setup to yd-agents-yaml.

findings.excerpt: python3 $S --removed-since <baseline>   # current is 0, or every remaining line has a reason to stay
